basic_check.title: Basic Check
basic_check.summary: Roll d616 and compare total against target number (TN).

edge.title: Edge
edge.summary: Roll an additional Marvel die and keep the higher Marvel die.

trouble.title: Trouble
trouble.summary: Roll an additional Marvel die and keep the lower Marvel die.

fantastic_success.title: Fantastic Success
fantastic_success.summary: When the Marvel die is 1, add +6 to the final result.
